question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
WITH word_sigs AS (
    SELECT 
        words,
        LENGTH(words) as len,
        array_sort(array_agg(words[i]::VARCHAR)) as sorted_chars
    FROM word_list, generate_series(1, LENGTH(words)) as i(i)
    WHERE words LIKE 'r%' AND LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5 
    GROUP BY words
),
sig_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        sorted_chars,
        COUNT(*) as sig_count
    FROM word_sigs
    GROUP BY sorted_chars
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT ws.words, ws.len, (sc.sig_count - 1) as anagram_count
FROM word_sigs ws
JOIN sig_counts sc ON ws.sorted_chars = sc.sorted_chars
WHERE ws.len BETWEEN 4 AND 5
ORDER BY ws.words
LIMIT 10

args.sql:
WITH word_sigs AS (
    SELECT 
        words,
        LENGTH(words) as len,
        array_sort(array_agg(words[i]::VARCHAR)) as sorted_chars
    FROM word_list, generate_series(1, LENGTH(words)) as i(i)
    WHERE words LIKE 'r%' AND LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5 
    GROUP BY words
),
sig_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        sorted_chars,
        COUNT(*) as sig_count
    FROM word_sigs
    GROUP BY sorted_chars
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_words
FROM word_sigs ws
JOIN sig_counts sc ON ws.sorted_chars = sc.sorted_chars
WHERE ws.len BETWEEN 4 AND 5
